coso_tooltips.p1: Commitment to integrity and ethical values (Code of Conduct).
coso_tooltips.p2: Board of Directors demonstrates independence and exercises oversight.
coso_tooltips.p3: Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and authorities.
coso_tooltips.p4: Commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.
coso_tooltips.p5: Individuals held accountable for their internal control responsibilities.
coso_tooltips.p6: Specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to identify risks.
coso_tooltips.p7: Identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives.
coso_tooltips.p8: Considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks.
coso_tooltips.p9: Identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact controls.
coso_tooltips.p10: Selects and develops control activities to mitigate risks.
coso_tooltips.p11: Selects and develops general control activities over technology (ITGC).
coso_tooltips.p12: Deploys control activities through policies and procedures.
coso_tooltips.p13: Obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information.
coso_tooltips.p14: Internally communicates information to support internal control.
coso_tooltips.p15: Communicates with external parties regarding internal control.
coso_tooltips.p17: Evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies.
